guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：LIGO 重力波觀測站
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: LIGO gravitational-wave observatories
guides.concept: 以漢福德與利文斯頓兩座 4 km 的 Advanced LIGO 干涉儀為對象，從應變 h = ΔL/L 與 1064 nm 雷射的相位讀出出發，推導臂腔精細度、循環功率、鍍膜熱雜訊、四重擺隔振、散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光的效果，再以光子校正器、雜訊預算、鎖定流程與觀測運行交接把 10⁻²³/√Hz 等級的靈敏度做成可驗證的工程。
guides.conceptEn: Using the two 4 km Advanced LIGO interferometers at Hanford and Livingston, this course starts from strain h = ΔL/L and phase readout with a 1064 nm laser, derives arm-cavity finesse, recycled power, coating thermal noise, quadruple-pendulum isolation, the shot-noise amplitude spectral density and the gain from squeezed light, then turns a sensitivity of order 10⁻²³/√Hz into verifiable engineering through photon calibrators, noise budgets, lock acquisition and observing-run handoff.
procedure: 重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。干涉儀以 1064 nm 的 Nd:YAG 雷射從分光鏡送入兩臂，回程光在輸出埠以接近暗紋的狀態干涉，微小的臂長差轉成輸出光功率的變化；DC 讀出法刻意保留約 10 pm 的偏移量，讓訊號與載波在光電二極體上線性混合。整個系統的邊界是：真空中的四面測試質量定義了臂長，其餘一切都是為了讓這四面鏡子只受重力波推動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每條臂由輸入測試質量（ITM，透射率約 1.4%）與末端測試質量（ETM，透射率數 ppm）組成 Fabry–Pérot 腔，光在腔內共振來回，使臂長變化造成的相位被放大約 2F/π 倍，但高於腔極點頻率的訊號會被平均掉。功率循環鏡把從暗紋輸出埠「反射」回雷射方向的光再送回干涉儀，使分光鏡處的功率提高數十倍；訊號循環鏡則調整輸出埠的頻率響應。這三層共振把 50 到 125 W 的入射功率轉成臂內數百 kW 的循環功率，代價是熱透鏡、輻射壓與鎖定的困難。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Advanced LIGO 的四面測試質量各重 40 kg、直徑 34 cm、厚 20 cm，由低吸收的熔融石英製成，正面鍍上數十層 SiO₂ 與摻鈦 Ta₂O₅ 的四分之一波長堆疊，反射率只讓每五百萬個光子穿透一個，吸收低於 1 ppm。鍍膜材料的機械損耗 φ 在室溫下透過漲落耗散定理產生布朗熱雜訊，使鏡面在雷射光斑範圍內隨機起伏，這是 50 到 500 Hz 最重要的雜訊之一；加大光斑半徑 w 與降低 φ 是僅有的兩條路。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每面測試質量掛在四級擺的最下層：上兩級為金屬質量，下兩級為熔融石英，最下一級以四根直徑約 400 µm 的熔融石英纖維與倒數第二級焊成單體懸吊，避免金屬絲的摩擦損耗。每一級擺在共振頻率以上提供 1/f² 的隔離，四級合起來約 1/f⁸；擺的上方還有主動隔振平台（ISI），以地震計與慣性感測器回授抵消地面與潮汐的低頻運動。這套組合把地面微米等級的震動在 10 Hz 以上壓到 10⁻¹⁹ m 以下，使測試質量成為近乎自由的慣性質量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

輸出埠的光子到達是泊松過程，功率起伏換算成等效的臂長雜訊，就是散粒雜訊；它與功率的平方根成反比，而臂腔極點以上的訊號響應下降，使散粒雜訊的等效應變在高頻隨頻率上升。LIGO 從 O3 起把壓縮真空態從輸出埠注入，把量子相位起伏壓低數 dB；O4 加入 300 m 的濾波腔產生頻率相依的壓縮，使低頻的輻射壓雜訊不因壓縮而惡化。散粒雜訊與輻射壓雜訊合稱量子雜訊，是靈敏度曲線在 100 Hz 以上的主要邊界。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

應變資料要有絕對刻度，LIGO 以光子校正器（Pcal）把一束功率調變的輔助雷射打在 ETM 上，用輻射壓產生已知的力，功率以可追溯到國家標準實驗室的功率計量測，使應變校正的不確定度達到百分之一等級；校正線連續注入，讓時間相依的讀出鏈增益可以即時追蹤。雜訊預算則把量子、鍍膜與懸吊熱雜訊、地震、牛頓、雷射頻率與強度、散射光與控制雜訊逐項以模型或注入量測估算，與實測靈敏度曲線相減，剩下的「未解釋雜訊」是調試的優先目標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

干涉儀有五個長度自由度（兩臂共模與差模、麥克森、功率循環腔、訊號循環腔）與數十個角度自由度，都要同時鎖在共振點上才能工作。高精細度臂腔的共振寬度只有約 1 nm，自由擺動的鏡子以微米每秒的速度掃過它，紅外光來不及建立共振，因此先用 532 nm 的倍頻光經臂長穩定系統（ALS）把臂長鎖到數奈米內，再切換到紅外鎖定、逐步提高功率。鎖定後由 Pound–Drever–Hall 式的射頻感測與波前感測器提供誤差訊號，數位控制系統以每秒 16384 次的速率驅動懸吊各級的致動器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一次觀測運行的交接包含：校正模型與不確定度、各頻段的雜訊預算、鎖定與重鎖程序、環境監測（地震計、麥克風、磁力計）通道清單、資料品質旗標定義，以及兩站的時間同步（GPS 對時至微秒以內）。偵測器的科學價值以雙中子星可探測距離（BNS range）與工作週期（duty cycle）量化，兩站同時運作才能壓低假警報率並做到天區定位；因此工程交接的目標不是單站的最佳靈敏度，而是網路的穩定與可重現性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals; LIGO's 4 km is a compromise between site, vacuum cost and signal. A 1064 nm Nd:YAG laser is split at the beam splitter into the two arms, the returning beams interfere near a dark fringe at the output port and a tiny arm-length difference becomes a change in output power; DC readout deliberately keeps an offset of about 10 pm so that signal and carrier mix linearly on the photodiode. The system boundary is that four test masses in vacuum define the arm lengths, and everything else exists to make those four mirrors move only under gravitational waves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each arm is a Fabry–Pérot cavity formed by the input test mass (ITM, transmission about 1.4%) and the end test mass (ETM, transmission of a few ppm); light resonates back and forth so the phase from an arm-length change is amplified by about 2F/π, while signals above the cavity-pole frequency are averaged away. The power-recycling mirror returns light that the dark output port reflects toward the laser back into the interferometer, raising the beam-splitter power tens of times, and the signal-recycling mirror shapes the frequency response at the output port. These three layers of resonance convert 50 to 125 W of input into hundreds of kilowatts circulating in the arms, at the price of thermal lensing, radiation pressure and difficult lock acquisition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Advanced LIGO's four test masses each weigh 40 kg, measure 34 cm across and 20 cm thick, and are made of low-absorption fused silica; their front faces carry tens of quarter-wave layers of SiO₂ and titania-doped Ta₂O₅ that let only one photon in five million through and absorb below 1 ppm. The mechanical loss φ of the coating materials produces Brownian thermal noise at room temperature through the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, making the surface fluctuate randomly within the laser spot; it is among the most important noises between 50 and 500 Hz, and enlarging the spot radius w or lowering φ are the only two remedies. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each test mass hangs at the bottom of a four-stage pendulum: the top two stages are metal, the lower two fused silica, and the final stage is welded to the penultimate mass through four fused-silica fibres about 400 µm in diameter, forming a monolithic suspension that avoids the frictional loss of metal wires. Each stage isolates as 1/f² above its resonance, so four stages give roughly 1/f⁸; above the pendulum an active isolation platform (ISI) uses seismometers and inertial sensors in feedback to cancel low-frequency ground and tidal motion. Together they reduce micrometre-scale ground vibration to below 10⁻¹⁹ m above 10 Hz, making the test mass an almost free inertial mass. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Photon arrivals at the output port form a Poisson process, and the power fluctuation expressed as equivalent arm-length noise is shot noise; it scales inversely with the square root of power, and because the signal response falls above the arm-cavity pole, the equivalent strain noise rises with frequency. Since O3 LIGO injects a squeezed vacuum into the output port, reducing the quantum phase fluctuation by several dB; O4 added a 300 m filter cavity for frequency-dependent squeezing so that low-frequency radiation-pressure noise is not worsened by the squeezing. Shot and radiation-pressure noise together form quantum noise, the main boundary of the sensitivity curve above 100 Hz. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Strain data need an absolute scale, so LIGO uses the photon calibrator (Pcal): a power-modulated auxiliary laser hits the ETM and its radiation pressure applies a known force, with the power measured by meters traceable to national metrology laboratories, bringing strain calibration uncertainty to the percent level; calibration lines are injected continuously so that time-dependent readout gains can be tracked. The noise budget estimates quantum, coating and suspension thermal, seismic, Newtonian, laser frequency and intensity, scattered-light and control noise term by term from models or injections, subtracts them from the measured curve, and the remaining unexplained noise becomes the commissioning priority. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The interferometer has five length degrees of freedom (common and differential arm, Michelson, power-recycling and signal-recycling cavities) and tens of angular ones, all of which must sit on resonance simultaneously. A high-finesse arm resonance is only about 1 nm wide and a freely swinging mirror sweeps through it at micrometres per second, too fast for the infrared light to build up, so 532 nm frequency-doubled light through the arm-length stabilisation system (ALS) first holds the arms within a few nanometres, after which the infrared lock is handed over and the power raised in steps. Once locked, Pound–Drever–Hall-type radio-frequency sensing and wavefront sensors provide error signals, and the digital control system drives the suspension actuators at 16384 samples per second. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The handoff for an observing run includes the calibration model and its uncertainty, the noise budget per frequency band, lock and relock procedures, the list of environmental channels (seismometers, microphones, magnetometers), data-quality flag definitions and the time synchronisation of the two sites (GPS to better than a microsecond). A detector's scientific value is quantified by the binary-neutron-star range and the duty cycle, and both sites must run together to suppress false alarms and localise sources on the sky; the goal of the engineering handoff is therefore not one site's best sensitivity but the stability and reproducibility of the network. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若輸出埠不在設計的暗紋偏移量上（例如偏移漂到 30 pm），載波功率過大使散粒雜訊與雷射強度雜訊同時上升，應變靈敏度在 100 Hz 附近劣化數十個百分比，而且訊號對臂長的線性關係也變差。
輸出鏈的光學損耗從 10% 升到 30%（例如法拉第隔離器退化或模式匹配變差）時，壓縮態被真空態稀釋，原本 6 dB 的壓縮只剩 2 dB，高頻靈敏度明顯退步，而單看雷射功率與鎖定狀態都正常。
pitfallsEn: If the output port drifts off the designed dark-fringe offset (for example to 30 pm), the excess carrier power raises both shot noise and laser-intensity coupling, strain sensitivity near 100 Hz degrades by tens of percent and the signal's linearity with arm length also suffers.

If optical loss in the output chain rises from 10% to 30%, for example from a degraded Faraday isolator or worse mode matching, the squeezed state is diluted by vacuum, 6 dB of squeezing collapses to 2 dB and high-frequency sensitivity visibly regresses while laser power and lock status look normal.

related.difference: 本課聚焦4 km Fabry–Pérot 麥克森干涉儀的應變量測：臂腔、40 kg 測試質量、四重擺、散粒雜訊與壓縮光；重力波干涉儀懸吊則以四級擺懸吊的隔振傳遞函數、熔融石英纖維熱雜訊與阻尼控制工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: LIGO 重力波觀測站
history.text: Rainer Weiss 在 1972 年的 MIT 報告中列出雷射干涉重力波偵測器的雜訊預算，之後與 Kip Thorne、Ronald Drever 推動由美國國家科學基金會資助的 LIGO 計畫；漢福德與利文斯頓兩站於 1990 年代末建成，初代 LIGO 在 2002 至 2010 年運行而未偵測到訊號。Advanced LIGO 於 2015 年啟用，同年 9 月 14 日記錄到第一個雙黑洞合併事件 GW150914，2017 年諾貝爾物理獎授予 Weiss、Barish 與 Thorne；之後各次觀測運行逐步加入壓縮光、頻率相依壓縮與更高功率。本課只重建公開文獻中的工程原理，不涉及任何內部設計文件。
history.textEn: Rainer Weiss's 1972 MIT report laid out the noise budget of a laser-interferometric gravitational-wave detector, and with Kip Thorne and Ronald Drever he drove the LIGO project funded by the US National Science Foundation; the Hanford and Livingston sites were completed in the late 1990s, and Initial LIGO ran from 2002 to 2010 without a detection. Advanced LIGO began operating in 2015 and on 14 September that year recorded the first binary-black-hole merger, GW150914; the 2017 Nobel Prize in Physics went to Weiss, Barish and Thorne, and subsequent observing runs added squeezed light, frequency-dependent squeezing and higher power. This course reconstructs only the engineering principles in public literature, not any internal design document.

history.text: 本課把「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」到「觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout" through "Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
